lines.zh: 八条细腿在冰上跑得飞快。
lines.en: Eight thin legs race across the ice.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根走，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I hug the wall base, keeping silent.

lines.zh: 冰面太亮，我专挑阴影走。
lines.en: The ice is bright; I keep to shadows.

lines.zh: 我的步子碎，像有人在敲指甲。
lines.en: My steps patter like fingernails tapping.

lines.zh: 走两步，回头看一眼。
lines.en: Two steps, then a glance back.

lines.zh: 我踩着同族的旧路，省力气。
lines.en: I follow an old trail of my kin to save effort.

lines.zh: 水面上我也能走，不会沉。
lines.en: I can walk on water too; I do not sink.

lines.zh: 冰缝里黑，我走得最自在。
lines.en: In dark ice cracks I move most freely.

lines.zh: 我的腿太多，转弯时容易打结。
lines.en: Too many legs; my turns get tangled.

lines.zh: 别跟来，我的路是绕的。
lines.en: Do not follow; my road loops.

lines.zh: 我踩过水洼，水面只晃了一下。
lines.en: I cross a puddle and the surface barely stirs.

lines.zh: 冰碴碎在脚下，我一步跨三道缝。
lines.en: Ice chips crackle as I clear three cracks in a step.

lines.zh: 我走在沉船的阴影里，谁也看不见。
lines.en: I walk in the wreck's shadow where no one sees.

lines.zh: 腿贴着冰面，凉得我直抖。
lines.en: Legs on the ice, the chill makes me tremble.

lines.zh: 我藏在冰缝里，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I hide in an ice crack, eyes only.

lines.zh: 我数着水里漂过的东西。
lines.en: I count the things drifting past in the water.

lines.zh: 那根线缠在腿上，我解了很久。
lines.en: A strand of string snared my leg; I worked it loose.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，像一块碎冰。
lines.en: Still, I look like a chip of ice.

lines.zh: 我听见冰下有东西在爬。
lines.en: I hear something crawling beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 有人来过，味道还留在石头上。
lines.en: Someone was here; their scent clings to the stone.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一团，等着。
lines.en: I fold myself into a ball and wait.

lines.zh: 水面上的倒影比我大。
lines.en: My reflection on the water is larger than I am.

lines.zh: 我摸到一块暖石头，就趴上去。
lines.en: I found a warm stone and lay on it.

lines.zh: 迷宫的墙记得每一个来过的人。
lines.en: The maze walls remember everyone who came.

lines.zh: 我把一根线绕在腿间，慢慢收。
lines.en: I wind a strand of string between my legs, slowly.

lines.zh: 冰缝里有风，我把身子堵住。
lines.en: Wind comes through the crack; I plug it with myself.

lines.zh: 我盯着水面的光，看了很久。
lines.en: I watch the light on the water for a long while.

lines.zh: 同族在远处敲冰，三下，两下。
lines.en: Kin tap the ice far off: three knocks, then two.

lines.zh: 你的口袋鼓着，我看见了。
lines.en: Your pocket bulges; I saw it.

lines.zh: 你走路的节奏很重，很好跟。
lines.en: Your tread is heavy and easy to follow.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，你看不出来。
lines.en: I do not blink, so you cannot tell.

lines.zh: 你的背包带松了，真好。
lines.en: Your pack strap is loose; how convenient.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我已经在另一边。
lines.en: When you look back, I am on the other side.

lines.zh: 你看墙，我看你手上的东西。
lines.en: You watch the wall; I watch your hands.

lines.zh: 你身上响的东西太多了。
lines.en: You carry too many things that jingle.

lines.zh: 你在找我，可我就在你脚边。
lines.en: You are searching for me; I am by your feet.

lines.zh: 你的靴子有一道旧裂缝。
lines.en: There is an old split in your boot.

lines.zh: 我记住你的脸了，下次还认得出。
lines.en: I have your face; I will know it again.

lines.zh: 你握紧的那只手，里面是什么。
lines.en: What is in that clenched hand of yours?

lines.zh: 你走得太直，迷宫不喜欢。
lines.en: You walk too straight; the maze dislikes it.

lines.zh: 我盯你盯得腿都酸了。
lines.en: I stared at you so long my legs ache.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，因为我一直没动。
lines.en: You cannot see me because I never moved.

lines.zh: 你的腰侧有个袋子，鼓鼓的。
lines.en: There is a pouch at your hip, and it looks full.

lines.zh: 你换了手拿灯，另一只手就空了。
lines.en: You switched hands on the lamp, leaving one free.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，从不直视。
lines.en: When I watch you, I never look straight on.

lines.zh: 你靴底沾着沉船的木屑。
lines.en: Your boot sole carries splinters from a wreck.

lines.zh: 我的腿断了两条，还能跑。
lines.en: Two legs broken, and I still run.

lines.zh: 这一下把我怀里的东西打掉了。
lines.en: The blow knocked the loot from my grip.

lines.zh: 我缩进冰缝，只露一条腿。
lines.en: I shrank into the crack, one leg showing.

lines.zh: 我太小，疼起来却很大。
lines.en: I am small, but the pain is not.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了，里面还是我。
lines.en: My shell cracked; inside, still me.

lines.zh: 别踩第二下，我跑不动了。
lines.en: No second stomp; I cannot run.

lines.zh: 我把偷的东西吐出来，换条命。
lines.en: I spat out my loot to buy my life.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记了很久。
lines.en: That one stayed with me a long while.

lines.zh: 我抖着腿，往暗处退。
lines.en: Legs shaking, I backed into the dark.

lines.zh: 疼得我连线都忘了拿。
lines.en: It hurt so much I forgot the string.

lines.zh: 你手里那根线，我要。
lines.en: That string in your hand: I want it.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我就爬上去。
lines.en: Lift it higher and I will climb for it.

lines.zh: 亮的东西，我忍不住。
lines.en: Shiny things; I cannot help myself.

lines.zh: 你放下包，走远一点。
lines.en: Set the bag down and step away.

lines.zh: 那颗珠子滚过来了，真好。
lines.en: That bead rolled toward me; lovely.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只想拿走。
lines.en: I do not eat it; I only want to take it.

lines.zh: 你把口袋按住，太明显了。
lines.en: Holding your pocket shut only makes it obvious.

lines.zh: 那东西在你腰后，我看得清楚。
lines.en: It hangs behind your hip; I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 我离你只有一步，忍得很辛苦。
lines.en: One step away from you; it is hard to wait.

lines.zh: 让我摸一下，就一下。
lines.en: Let me touch it, just once.

lines.zh: 我撞进你靴子，被弹开老远。
lines.en: I hit your boot and bounced far off.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的腿，我丢了一条。
lines.en: You stepped on a leg; I left it behind.

lines.zh: 我从你脚背上跑过去了。
lines.en: I ran right over your foot.

lines.zh: 撞上你时，我怀里的东西掉了。
lines.en: When I hit you, my loot fell out.

lines.zh: 我太小，撞你像掉下一粒沙。
lines.en: I am so small, hitting you is a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖把我顶到墙边。
lines.en: Your knee knocked me against the wall.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的裤腿爬了一下。
lines.en: I climbed your trouser leg a little.

lines.zh: 别跺脚，我在你鞋底下面。
lines.en: Do not stamp; I am under your sole.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我们两个都停了。
lines.en: We both stopped after that collision.

lines.zh: 你根本没感觉到我。
lines.en: You did not feel me at all.

lines.zh: 冰缝深处，还有一只在等我。
lines.en: Deep in the crack, another waits for me.

lines.zh: 我们交换偷来的东西，算是礼。
lines.en: We trade stolen things as gifts.

lines.zh: 两只爬行者碰触角，很轻。
lines.en: Two scuttlers touch antennae, lightly.

lines.zh: 它偷的比我多，我不服气。
lines.en: It steals more than I do; I resent that.

lines.zh: 我们在同一道冰缝里过夜。
lines.en: We spend the night in the same ice crack.

lines.zh: 卵藏在沉船的木板下。
lines.en: The eggs hide under wreck planks.

lines.zh: 它替我望风，我替它搬货。
lines.en: It keeps watch while I carry the loot.

lines.zh: 我们的腿碰在一起，像打结。
lines.en: Our legs meet and knot together.

lines.zh: 这一窝里，只有我们两只活下来。
lines.en: Of the clutch, only we two lived.

lines.zh: 天亮前，它就得走。
lines.en: Before dawn, it must go.

lines.zh: 这颗珠子归我了，先含在嘴里。
lines.en: This bead is mine; I hold it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我抱起一块铁片，比我还宽。
lines.en: I lift an iron scrap wider than I am.

lines.zh: 线缠住我了，正好带走。
lines.en: The string tangled me; I will take it along.

lines.zh: 你掉的那枚钉子，我收下了。
lines.en: I have taken the nail you dropped.

lines.zh: 我一次能抱三样，第四样用腿夹。
lines.en: Three at once, a fourth between my legs.

lines.zh: 太重了，我拖着走，留下划痕。
lines.en: Too heavy; I drag it, leaving a scratch.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进沉船的缝里。
lines.en: I stuff my loot into a gap in the wreck.

lines.zh: 捡东西要快，别让人看见。
lines.en: Grab it fast, before anyone sees.

lines.zh: 我的窝里已经有十七样了。
lines.en: My nest holds seventeen things already.

lines.zh: 这一件我要藏得最深。
lines.en: This one I will hide the deepest.

lines.zh: 那个人把东西放进了口袋。
lines.en: That one put something in a pocket.

lines.zh: 我看见了，亮闪闪的一枚。
lines.en: I saw it: one shiny piece.

lines.zh: 他一个人，走路还东张西望。
lines.en: He is alone and keeps looking around.

lines.zh: 那包东西挂得太靠外了。
lines.en: That bundle hangs too far out.

lines.zh: 他停下来系鞋带，机会来了。
lines.en: He stopped to tie a boot; my chance.

lines.zh: 这只手比上一个松。
lines.en: This hand is looser than the last.

lines.zh: 他在看地图，正好。
lines.en: He is reading a map; perfect.

lines.zh: 背包没扣好，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: The pack is unclasped; I see it plainly.

lines.zh: 那个东西在他腰后晃了很久。
lines.en: It has swung behind his hip a long while.

lines.zh: 我先跟着，等他坐下。
lines.en: I will follow and wait for him to sit.

lines.zh: 他从沉船里拿走了我的东西。
lines.en: He took my things from the wreck.

lines.zh: 这人的脚步乱了，好动手。
lines.en: His steps have gone uneven; good for me.

lines.zh: 我要那件，不要别的。
lines.en: I want that piece, not the rest.

lines.zh: 他只是路过，我等下一个。
lines.en: He is only passing; I will wait for the next.

lines.zh: 他弯腰捡东西，背全空着。
lines.en: He bent to pick something up, back wide open.

lines.zh: 那个包带断了一半。
lines.en: That pack strap is half broken.

lines.zh: 我伏在他影子里，跟着走。
lines.en: I crouch in his shadow and follow.

lines.zh: 他每停一次，我就近一尺。
lines.en: Each time he stops, I close a foot.

lines.zh: 我在等他把手松开。
lines.en: I am waiting for his hand to loosen.

lines.zh: 八条腿收在身下，蓄着劲。
lines.en: All eight legs are drawn beneath me, coiled.

lines.zh: 他背对着我，呼吸很匀。
lines.en: His back is to me; his breathing is even.

lines.zh: 墙角到他的包，只有四步。
lines.en: Four steps from the corner to his pack.

lines.zh: 我把身体压得比石头还低。
lines.en: I press myself lower than the stones.

lines.zh: 他低头的时候，就是时候。
lines.en: When he looks down, it is time.

lines.zh: 我不急，偷东西靠等。
lines.en: I am patient; stealing is waiting.

lines.zh: 他的手指离那枚扣子很远。
lines.en: His fingers are far from that clasp.

lines.zh: 冰面会响，我得挑软的地方踩。
lines.en: Ice creaks; I must choose soft footing.

lines.zh: 他打了个哈欠，眼睛闭上了。
lines.en: He yawned; his eyes closed.

lines.zh: 再近半尺，就够得着。
lines.en: Half a foot closer and I can reach.

lines.zh: 我数到三就动。
lines.en: I move when I count to three.

lines.zh: 我数着他腰带上的扣眼。
lines.en: I count the eyelets on his belt.

lines.zh: 他的灯往左偏，我往右挪。
lines.en: His lamp leans left; I shift right.

lines.zh: 我等他弯腰，那只要一秒。
lines.en: I wait for him to bend; it takes one second.

lines.zh: 八条腿收得更紧，我贴地了。
lines.en: All eight legs tucked tighter; I am flat to the ground.

lines.zh: 我跳上他的手背，咬了一口。
lines.en: I leapt onto his hand and bit.

lines.zh: 我的牙小，可咬得准。
lines.en: My teeth are small but they land true.

lines.zh: 我扑向他的指节，抓了一下。
lines.en: I lunged at his knuckle and clawed.

lines.zh: 这一下只够让他松手。
lines.en: That was just enough to make him let go.

lines.zh: 我挂在他袖子上，晃着咬。
lines.en: I hung from his sleeve, biting as I swung.

lines.zh: 他甩手，我被摔到墙上。
lines.en: He shook his arm and flung me at the wall.

lines.zh: 我咬的是带子，不是肉。
lines.en: I bit the strap, not the flesh.

lines.zh: 我的腿缠住他的手腕。
lines.en: My legs wrapped around his wrist.

lines.zh: 这一口换来了那枚扣子。
lines.en: That bite bought me the clasp.

lines.zh: 我不敢多留，咬完就跑。
lines.en: I do not linger; I bite and run.

lines.zh: 他的护甲太滑，我抓不住。
lines.en: His armor is too slick to grip.

lines.zh: 我从背后动手，最省力。
lines.en: I strike from behind; it costs least.

lines.zh: 他挥了一下，我早就不在那儿。
lines.en: He swung, but I was already gone.

lines.zh: 我咬完才发现咬的是自己的线。
lines.en: I bit, then found I had bitten my own string.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在他手腕内侧。
lines.en: I rammed the inside of his wrist.

lines.zh: 我咬住袋口，往下坠。
lines.en: I bit the pouch mouth and dropped my weight.

lines.zh: 我从沉船的缝里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawled out of a gap in the wreck.

lines.zh: 冰水退了，露出一窝我们。
lines.en: The ice water withdrew and exposed our clutch.

lines.zh: 我出生时，嘴里已经叼着东西。
lines.en: I was born with something already in my mouth.

lines.zh: 迷宫给了我一条腿，也给了我一条路。
lines.en: The maze gave me a leg and a road.

lines.zh: 第一件事，是找能拿走的东西。
lines.en: My first act: find something to take.

lines.zh: 我比同窝的小，所以跑得快。
lines.en: I was the smallest of the clutch, so I run fastest.

lines.zh: 冰缝里很挤，我们挤了一夜。
lines.en: The crack was crowded; we packed in all night.

lines.zh: 我踩着同族的背爬了上来。
lines.en: I climbed out over my siblings' backs.

lines.zh: 那根线，是我出生时缠上的。
lines.en: That string was on me from birth.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，就看见了沉船的桅杆。
lines.en: I opened my eyes on a wreck's mast.

lines.zh: 水面浮起一层白，我就出来了。
lines.en: A white film rose on the water, and I came out.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这迷宫多一双眼睛。
lines.en: From today the maze has one more pair of eyes.

lines.zh: 我学会了第一件事：不出声。
lines.en: I learned my first lesson: make no sound.

lines.zh: 出生时的味道，是铁和盐。
lines.en: The smell of my birth was iron and salt.

lines.zh: 潮水把我从裂缝里推出来。
lines.en: The tide pushed me out of the crack.

lines.zh: 我第一次睁眼，看到冰下的光。
lines.en: My first sight was light under the ice.

lines.zh: 沉船墓地多了一个住户。
lines.en: The ship graveyard has one more tenant.

lines.zh: 我出生时什么都没带，所以什么都想拿。
lines.en: I was born with nothing, so I want to take everything.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的腿，我闻到自己焦了。
lines.en: Flame caught my legs; I smelled myself scorching.

lines.zh: 从桅杆上摔下，我半天没动。
lines.en: I fell from the mast and lay still a while.

lines.zh: 我不该在水面停那么久。
lines.en: I should not have rested on the water so long.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀进了冰缝。
lines.en: The blast threw me into an ice crack.

lines.zh: 箭把我钉在木板上，我挣了很久。
lines.en: An arrow pinned me to a plank; I struggled long.

lines.zh: 那股魔力把我怀里的东西都吸走了。
lines.en: That magic pulled all my loot away.

lines.zh: 偷来的都不能吃，我饿着。
lines.en: None of my loot is food; I go hungry.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的腿全麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and numbed all my legs.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有东西可偷。
lines.en: In the void there is nothing to steal.
